The ''[[Nova Defiant/Legends|Nova Defiant]]'' was '''ambushed''' during the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Republic Star Destroyers]] took the ship under fire near [[Innton II]], a lightly populated world Rimward of the [[Triton system/Legends|Triton system]], just off the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The ''Nova Defiant'' crashed down on Innton II. Later the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] turned the wreck into a [[Defiant Core|base]].<ref name="SoR" />
